title: 白鶴灘水壩~Baihetan Dam
focus: 百萬千瓦機組與高拱壩多尺度~Gigawatt units and multiple scales of a high arch dam
summary: 白鶴灘案例連結柱狀節理岩體、低熱混凝土與大型水輪發電機，從局部剛度及熱量一路推到轉矩、視在功率、冷卻和調速介面。課程刻意分開實際裝機規模與假想材料參數，並要求學員對每個簡化模型提出可驗證觀察及升級分析條件。~The Baihetan case connects jointed rock, low-heat concrete and large turbine-generators, moving from local stiffness and thermal energy to torque, apparent power, cooling and governor interfaces. Actual installed scale is separated from assumed material parameters. Each simplified model requires an observable verification method and a stated condition for more advanced analysis.
history: 三峽集團官方報導記錄白鶴灘十六部百萬千瓦機組於二〇二二年十二月全部投產。本課以此機組尺度為背景，但不把單機功率直接換成結構載重，也不沿用報導的世界排名作永久結論。教材中的岩體方向剛度、混凝土熱性質及機電效率都是原創假設，需要另行試驗才能使用於工程。歷史監測手冊僅作資料方法索引，二〇二六年的來源核對不表示工程在該年新增完工。~The official Three Gorges report records all sixteen million-kilowatt Baihetan units operating in December 2022. That scale motivates the course, but unit power is not converted directly into structural load, and contemporary world rankings are not presented as permanent facts. Directional rock stiffness, concrete thermal properties and electromechanical efficiencies are original assumptions requiring testing before engineering use. Historical instrumentation manuals provide methodological indexing, while the 2026 source check is not a new completion event.
example: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」及「巨型機組軸轉矩」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m；第二組為 binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。~This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Columnar joint series compliance, then compare the controlling variables in Low heat cement adiabatic rise and Gigawatt unit shaft torque. The first calculation is kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m; the second is binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.

units.anchor: 柱狀節理串聯柔度~Columnar joint series compliance
units.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度~Columnar joint series compliance
units.mechanism: 柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。當載重路徑依序通過岩塊及節理，兩者變形可在簡化一維模型中相加，等效剛度由柔度相加求得。這種尺度分析幫助理解很薄的弱介面為何可能主導整體變形，但不代表真實三維節理網絡。 串聯元件承受相同力，平行元件則共享位移，先確認物理連接才能決定應加剛度還是加柔度。~Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip. A load path passing sequentially through rock and an interface permits additive displacements in a simplified one-dimensional model, with compliances added to obtain equivalent stiffness. A thin weak interface can dominate deformation, though the model does not represent a three-dimensional joint network. Elements in series carry equal force, whereas parallel elements share displacement; the physical connection determines whether stiffnesses or compliances should be added in the model.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m。模型邊界：單一串聯線彈性載重路徑，兩元件同力且不滑移。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m. Model boundary: one linear elastic series path with equal force in both elements and no sliding.
units.verify: 用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。若主要變形集中在界面，應優先辨認節理閉合；若卸載後殘留位移大，串聯彈簧需改為非線性接觸模型。~Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately. Interface-dominated movement points toward joint closure, while substantial residual movement after unloading requires nonlinear contact behavior rather than two purely elastic series springs.
units.failure: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。~Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Opening or sliding can change the path itself, so one reduced constant stiffness cannot describe every loading stage and contact condition.
units.misconception: 串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加~Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly.
units.practice: 將節理剛度提高一倍重算等效剛度，再比較只提高岩塊剛度的效果，指出試驗與處理資源應優先釐清哪一個變形來源。~Double joint stiffness and recompute the equivalent value, then compare doubling only block stiffness. Identify which deformation source should receive priority in testing and in evaluating a proposed treatment.

units.anchor: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升~Low heat cement adiabatic rise
units.title: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升~Low heat cement adiabatic rise
units.mechanism: 低熱水泥減少或延緩水化放熱，但大體積混凝土仍可能累積顯著溫升。教材以膠結料用量乘單位放熱量，再除混凝土體積熱容量估算絕熱上升尺度。放熱隨齡期改變，骨材與摻料也影響熱容量，因此材料名稱本身不能替代實測溫升曲線。 單位膠結料放熱量必須附齡期，早期與最終放熱不能混用，否則低熱材料延遲放熱的特徵會被抹平。~Low-heat cement reduces or delays hydration heat, but mass concrete can still accumulate a substantial temperature rise. Binder content times specific heat release divided by concrete volumetric heat capacity estimates an adiabatic scale. Age-dependent hydration, aggregates and supplementary materials alter the response, so a material name cannot replace a measured temperature-rise curve. Specific binder heat release requires an age; mixing early and final heat values erases the delayed-release behavior that matters when comparing low-heat materials.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。模型邊界：假定指定齡期放熱全被保留的絕熱估算，不含散熱及水化動力學。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K. Model boundary: adiabatic estimate retaining all stated age-specific heat, excluding heat loss and hydration kinetics.
units.verify: 對實際配比做絕熱或半絕熱試驗，核對試件齡期、初溫與摻料比例，再與現場核心溫度及冷卻帳比較。若現場峰值較低，應查散熱與放熱時間，而非直接宣稱水泥單位放熱量不同。~Test the actual mix adiabatically or semi-adiabatically, matching age, starting temperature and supplementary materials, then compare core temperatures and cooling accounts. A lower field peak calls for examining heat exchange and timing before concluding that the cement specific heat release has changed.
units.failure: 低熱不等於無熱，若忽略保溫邊界仍可能低估核心溫升；過快表面降溫又可能提高梯度，所以降低總熱量不能單獨保證沒有溫度裂縫。~Low heat is not zero heat, and an insulating boundary can still permit a high core temperature. Rapid surface cooling can increase gradients, so a reduced total heat release alone cannot guarantee the absence of thermal cracking.
units.misconception: 使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度~Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature.
units.practice: 改變膠結料用量與比熱各一成，分別重算溫升，建立敏感度表，再列出要從絕熱尺度轉成現地溫度歷程所需的邊界條件。~Change binder content and heat capacity by ten percent separately, recalculate rise and build a sensitivity table. List boundary conditions needed to convert the adiabatic scale into a field temperature history.

units.anchor: 巨型機組軸轉矩~Gigawatt unit shaft torque
units.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩~Gigawatt unit shaft torque
units.mechanism: 百萬千瓦級機組的低速軸系需傳遞很大的轉矩，機械功率與電端功率要先分清楚。教材把指定軸功率除以角速度，得到平均扭矩，再討論法蘭、軸承與轉輪連接的載重路徑。平均扭矩不能表示扭振峰值，也不能由單機容量推論材料應力。 若功率以兆瓦輸入而角速度以每秒計，所得扭矩自然是兆牛頓米，但弧度的無因次慣例仍需說明。~A low-speed gigawatt-class shaft transmits large torque, and mechanical power must be distinguished from terminal electrical power. Divide specified shaft power by angular speed for mean torque, then trace loads through flanges, bearings and runner connections. Mean torque does not describe torsional peaks or determine material stress from unit capacity alone. With megawatts and angular speed per second, torque is naturally in meganewton-metres; the dimensionless-radian convention should still be understood when checking the units.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pshaft=1000 MW; n=120 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=Pshaft/omega=79.57747155 MN*m。模型邊界：假想恆速軸端功率，未含載重拒絕與扭振。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pshaft=1000 MW; n=120 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=Pshaft/omega=79.57747155 MN*m. Model boundary: hypothetical constant-speed shaft power, excluding load rejection and torsional oscillation.
units.verify: 對照軸速、電端功率及損失估計，先確認功率邊界一致，再把扭振頻譜與平均轉矩分開報告。若接頭局部應變偏高而平均功率正常，應研究偏心、載重分配及應力集中，不用總功率排除機械問題。~Align shaft speed, terminal power and loss estimates to a common boundary, reporting torsional spectra separately from mean torque. High local connection strain at normal mean power calls for examining eccentricity, load distribution and stress concentration rather than using total power to dismiss a mechanical problem.
units.failure: 軸系接頭鬆動可能造成週期滑移與局部峰值，平均扭矩帳仍會閉合；若錯把轉速每分鐘當每秒，則會把所有後續扭矩與應力估算帶入單位錯誤。~A loose shaft connection can produce cyclic slip and local peaks while the mean torque account still closes. Confusing revolutions per minute with per second introduces a unit error into every subsequent torque and stress estimate based on that speed.
units.misconception: 機組平均功率正常就代表接頭局部應力正常~Normal mean unit power proves that local connection stresses are normal.
units.practice: 保持軸功率並改變轉速，計算平均轉矩曲線，再畫接頭傳力圖，指出還需哪些幾何與動態資料才能評估局部螺栓或法蘭應力。~Hold shaft power fixed while varying speed and plot mean torque. Draw the connection load path and identify geometric and dynamic information needed to assess local bolt or flange stress.

units.anchor: 發電端電流尺度~Generator terminal current scale
units.title: 發電端電流尺度~Generator terminal current scale
units.mechanism: 大型發電機電流由三相實功、線電壓及功率因數共同決定，電壓提高會降低同功率電流，但不能因此忽略絕緣與故障需求。教材在平衡正弦條件下計算線電流，並辨認線電壓與相電壓的差異。導體溫升、短路力及局部放電需另行驗證。 每相電流與線電流是否相等取決於接線方式，本例使用平衡系統的線量關係，不可未確認就套入繞組損失。~Large-generator current depends on three-phase active power, line voltage and power factor. Raising voltage lowers current at fixed power but introduces insulation and fault considerations. Calculate line current for balanced sinusoidal operation while distinguishing line from phase voltage; conductor heating, short-circuit forces and partial discharge remain separate assessments. Whether phase and line current match depends on connection; this example uses balanced-system line quantities and cannot enter winding-loss calculations without checking that distinction.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P=1000000000 W; Vline=24000 V; pf=0.90 (dimensionless); I=P/(sqrt(3)*Vline*pf)/1000=26.72917913 kA。模型邊界：平衡三相正弦穩態，以線電壓計算線電流；非短路電流。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P=1000000000 W; Vline=24000 V; pf=0.90 (dimensionless); I=P/(sqrt(3)*Vline*pf)/1000=26.72917913 kA. Model boundary: balanced sinusoidal three-phase steady state using line voltage for line current, not fault current.
units.verify: 校驗三相電壓電流相量與功率因數定義，核對電流互感器比值及相序，再比較總實功與三相分量。若某相電流異常但總功率近似不變，應查不平衡與量測問題，不只用平均電流。~Verify three-phase phasors, power-factor convention, current-transformer ratio and phase sequence, then compare total power with individual phases. An unusual phase current at similar total power requires checking imbalance and instrumentation rather than relying on one average current for the machine.
units.failure: 線電壓誤作相電壓會造成根號三倍誤差，低功率因數又可能在實功未增加時提高電流；忽略這兩項會低估導體與冷卻系統負擔。~Confusing line and phase voltage introduces a square-root-of-three error, while reduced power factor can raise current without increasing active power. Ignoring these effects understates conductor loading and cooling demand even at an unchanged generating output.
units.misconception: 實功固定時功率因數不會影響電流~Power factor cannot affect current when active power is fixed.
units.practice: 固定電壓和實功，對三種功率因數計算電流及電流平方比例，再說明為何銅損比較仍需導體溫度下的電阻資料。~At fixed voltage and active power, calculate current and current-squared ratios for three power factors. Explain why comparing copper loss still requires resistance measured at the relevant conductor temperature.

units.anchor: 通風散熱體積流~Ventilation cooling volume flow
units.title: 通風散熱體積流~Ventilation cooling volume flow
units.mechanism: 以空氣帶走發電機熱量時，體積流量須先乘密度轉成質量流率，再乘比熱與溫升。海拔、溫度和壓力會改變密度，因此相同風量不一定帶走相同熱量。教材求理想需求流量後，還要檢查風路分配、壓降與局部熱點，不能只看風機銘牌。 空氣密度應對應量測斷面的壓力與溫度，標準風量和實際風量需要換算後才能放進同一熱量帳。~Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise. Altitude, temperature and pressure change density, so equal volume flow may remove different heat. After estimating ideal demand, examine distribution, pressure drop and hotspots rather than relying on a fan nameplate alone. Air density must match pressure and temperature at the measurement section; standard and actual volume flows require conversion before they belong in one thermal account.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s。模型邊界：穩態完全混合且全部熱由此氣流帶走，不含旁通與漏風。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s. Model boundary: steady complete mixing with all heat carried by this airflow, excluding bypass and leakage.
units.verify: 在進出口量測溫度、密度條件與風速分布，使用斷面積分而非單點最高風速。若總熱量帳吻合但局部繞組過熱，應查分流及死區；若風機功率增加而有效風量不增，則查阻力及漏風。~Measure inlet-outlet temperature, density conditions and velocity distribution, integrating the section rather than using its peak velocity. A closing total heat account with hot windings indicates flow maldistribution. Greater fan power without more effective flow calls for checking resistance and leakage.
units.failure: 風道旁通可讓量測總風量正常卻繞過熱源，局部堵塞也可能在平均溫升不高時形成熱點；若沿用標準密度，則會把高溫空氣的熱容量估高。~A bypass can preserve measured total airflow while avoiding the heat source, and local blockage can create hotspots despite modest mean temperature rise. Using standard density for hot air also overestimates its heat-carrying capacity at the stated volume flow.
units.misconception: 相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力~Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability.
units.practice: 將空氣密度降低一成重算需求風量，再加入兩條不均等風路，說明哪些測點能確認熱源真正得到冷卻，而非只看到總風量。~Lower air density by ten percent and recalculate required volume flow. Add two unequal airflow paths and identify measurements that verify cooling at the heat source rather than only total delivered airflow.

units.anchor: 調速下垂靜態尺度~Governor droop static scale
units.title: 調速下垂靜態尺度~Governor droop static scale
units.mechanism: 調速下垂使頻率降低時機組增加功率，但其靜態斜率不等於瞬時能提供的響應。導葉速度、水錘、轉動慣量及保護限制決定暫態過程。教材以無因次下垂和頻率偏差估算理想增功率，要求另查機組餘裕，避免在已滿載時仍假設無限調節能力。 下垂係數的百分比是頻率相對變化與額定功率相對變化之比，若把赫茲直接除百分數會失去量綱一致性。~Governor droop increases requested power as frequency falls, but the static slope is not instantaneous delivered response. Guide-vane speed, water hammer, inertia and protection shape the transient. Use dimensionless droop and frequency deviation to estimate an ideal increment, then check headroom rather than assuming unlimited response from a fully loaded machine. Droop relates relative frequency change to relative rated-power change; dividing raw hertz directly by a percentage loses the dimensional consistency of the normalized relation.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f0=50 Hz; df=-0.25 Hz; R=0.05 (dimensionless); Prated=1000 MW; dP=-(df/f0)/R*Prated=100 MW。模型邊界：無死區及飽和的靜態下垂關係，未含水力暫態。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f0=50 Hz; df=-0.25 Hz; R=0.05 (dimensionless); Prated=1000 MW; dP=-(df/f0)/R*Prated=100 MW. Model boundary: static droop without deadband or saturation, excluding hydraulic transients.
units.verify: 對齊頻率、功率指令、導葉開度與電端出力，分別估計靜態增益及動態延遲。若指令增加但出力受限，應檢查餘裕和水力限制；若頻率量測有濾波延遲，不能把全部延遲歸因於機械執行器。~Align frequency, power request, guide-vane position and terminal output, separating static gain from dynamic delay. A rising request with limited output requires checking headroom and hydraulic constraints. Frequency-filter delay must not be attributed entirely to the mechanical actuator in the response diagnosis.
units.failure: 直接提高調速增益可能與水力延遲形成振盪，靜態公式看似增強支援卻降低動態穩定；忽略功率上限則會高估事故期間可提供的頻率響應。~Increasing governor gain can interact with hydraulic delay and create oscillation, improving the static formula while degrading dynamic behavior. Ignoring the power ceiling also overstates the frequency response available during a disturbance in the interconnected system.
units.misconception: 下垂公式算出的增功率會瞬間全部到位~The power increment from the droop formula is delivered completely and instantaneously.
units.practice: 設定兩種可用功率餘裕，將理想響應截限後比較，再畫出有執行器延遲的概念曲線，指出哪些測試才能辨識靜態與動態參數。~Set two headroom limits, clip the ideal response and compare them. Sketch a delayed actuator response and identify tests that distinguish static droop from the dynamic parameters of the hydraulic-machine system.

units.anchor: 高頻訊號混疊~High frequency signal aliasing
units.title: 高頻訊號混疊~High frequency signal aliasing
units.mechanism: 大型機組監測若取樣頻率不足，高頻壓力或振動會折返到較低頻段，形成不存在的故障特徵。取樣理論需與類比防混疊濾波共同考慮，單純增加資料點顯示密度不會恢復已遺失資訊。教材計算一個折返頻率，再要求用原始取樣與濾波規格驗證。 取樣前的類比濾波與取樣後數位濾波作用不同，前者防止折返進入資料，後者只能處理已記錄頻帶。~Insufficient sampling folds high-frequency pressure or vibration into lower bands and creates misleading fault signatures. Sampling must be considered with analog anti-alias filtering; plotting more interpolated points cannot restore lost information. Calculate one alias frequency and verify it against the original acquisition and filtering specifications before diagnosing machinery. Analog filtering before sampling and digital filtering afterward serve different roles: the former prevents folding, while the latter only processes frequencies already represented in the record.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz。模型邊界：此頻率位於第一個折返區間且無有效防混疊濾波，非一般多區間公式。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz. Model boundary: this signal lies in the first folding interval without effective anti-alias filtering; not a general multi-band formula.
units.verify: 查原始取樣率、類比濾波截止及感測器頻寬，再以較高取樣率重測同一工況。若低頻峰隨取樣率改變而移動，支持混疊而非機械模態；若峰保持物理頻率，仍需結合轉速與相位判讀。~Check original sampling rate, analog cutoff and sensor bandwidth, then repeat the operating point at a higher rate. A low-frequency peak moving with sample rate supports aliasing rather than a mechanical mode; a stable physical frequency still needs speed and phase evidence for interpretation.
units.failure: 軟體後處理低通無法移除已折返而混入有效頻帶的訊號，插值也不會創造新資訊；若據此調整機組，可能處理根本不存在的低頻激振。~A digital low-pass applied afterward cannot remove a folded signal already overlapping the useful band, and interpolation creates no new information. Acting on such a spectrum can lead to attempts to fix a low-frequency excitation that does not physically exist.
units.misconception: 取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊~Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing.
units.practice: 對兩個取樣率計算同一真實頻率的顯示位置，畫出頻譜折返，再提出類比濾波與取樣設定，說明為何僅改圖表解析度無效。~Calculate the apparent frequency of one real signal at two sampling rates and sketch folding. Propose analog filtering and acquisition settings and explain why changing chart resolution alone cannot correct the data.

units.anchor: 摻氣體積分率~Aeration volume fraction
units.title: 摻氣體積分率~Aeration volume fraction
units.mechanism: 洩洪摻氣使水氣混合流的密度與可壓縮性改變，空氣體積流量必須附壓力和溫度條件。以同一位置的氣水體積流量求表觀體積分率，可作供氣尺度帳，但氣液滑移會讓局部空隙率不同。不能把入口空氣比例直接當成底板表面的保護效果。 氣液滑移意味兩相停留時間不同，流量比例與瞬時體積占比因此可能不同，應先定義所需含氣指標。~Aeration changes mixture density and compressibility, and air volume flow needs a pressure-temperature reference. Gas and liquid volume rates at one location give a superficial fraction for supply accounting, while phase slip can produce a different local void fraction. Inlet air proportion does not directly establish protective conditions at the floor. Phase slip gives gas and liquid different residence times, so flow-rate fraction can differ from instantaneous occupied-volume fraction; define the required aeration measure first.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qa=90 m3/s; Qw=510 m3/s; beta=Qa/(Qa+Qw)=0.15。模型邊界：氣水流量在同一壓力溫度截面，表觀流量分率而非局部空隙率。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qa=90 m3/s; Qw=510 m3/s; beta=Qa/(Qa+Qw)=0.15. Model boundary: gas and water rates at the same pressure-temperature section; superficial flow fraction rather than local void fraction.
units.verify: 核對空氣流量計的標準狀態換算，再量測不同深度的含氣分布與底板壓力。若總供氣量正常但近壁空氣不足，應研究滑移及再分布；不能只用供氣管的單一數字宣稱表面保護充分。~Check standard-state conversion of the air meter and measure depth-dependent air content with floor pressure. Normal total supply with inadequate near-wall air calls for examining slip and redistribution rather than declaring protection sufficient from one reading in the air-supply pipe.
units.failure: 氣管壓力升高會壓縮空氣而改變體積流率，若不換算就會錯估分率；水氣相對速度不同又可能使高平均含氣量與低近壁含氣量同時存在。~Increasing air-line pressure compresses gas and changes volume rate, distorting the fraction if no conversion is made. Different phase velocities can also allow high average air content to coexist with inadequate air close to the solid boundary.
units.misconception: 入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率~The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor.
units.practice: 將空氣流量換成另一壓力狀態後重算分率，再設計兩個相同平均含氣量但近壁分布不同的剖面，指出需要哪種量測區分。~Convert air flow to another pressure condition and recalculate the fraction. Construct profiles with equal mean air content but different near-wall distributions and identify the measurements needed to distinguish them.

units.anchor: 水工模型尺度律~Hydraulic model scaling law
units.title: 水工模型尺度律~Hydraulic model scaling law
units.mechanism: 重力主導的自由水面模型常以福祿相似配對流速與長度，流量尺度因此是長度比的二分之五次方，而非線性放大。模型能呈現某些水面與慣性作用，卻未必同時保持雷諾數、表面張力及汽蝕相似。每項結論應對應其被保留的物理機制。 福祿尺度下時間比為長度比平方根，影像播放速度若未換算，會錯判原型水舌波動與閘門變動的時序。~Gravity-dominated free-surface models often preserve Froude similarity, linking velocity and length and giving discharge a length-ratio exponent of five halves. Such a model can represent selected surface and inertial behavior without simultaneously preserving Reynolds, surface-tension or cavitation similarity. Every interpretation should identify the physical mechanism actually preserved. Under Froude scaling, time ratio is the square root of length ratio; unconverted video speed can misrepresent prototype jet fluctuations and gate-motion timing.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：lambdaL=40 (dimensionless); Qm=0.12 m3/s; Qp=Qm*lambdaL**2.5=1214.3146215 m3/s。模型邊界：長度比為原型除模型，重力相同的福祿流量尺度。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: lambdaL=40 (dimensionless); Qm=0.12 m3/s; Qp=Qm*lambdaL**2.5=1214.3146215 m3/s. Model boundary: length ratio is prototype divided by model with equal gravity and Froude discharge scaling.
units.verify: 先核對幾何縮尺與所有測具位置，再用速度、水深及流量三種尺度互相驗算。比較不同模型尺寸的含氣與表面現象，若結果隨尺寸改變，應辨認尺度效應，不把較細緻照片當作更準確的原型預測。~Verify geometric scale and sensor positions, then cross-check velocity, depth and discharge scaling. Compare aeration and surface behavior in different model sizes. Size-dependent results require identifying scale effects rather than treating more detailed photographs as inherently more accurate prototype predictions.
units.failure: 小模型表面張力及黏性可能相對放大，含氣與小尺度破碎不再保持相似；直接把模型汽穴或侵蝕量按幾何比例放大，會超出福祿相似能支持的結論。~Surface tension and viscosity can be relatively stronger in a small model, preventing similarity of aeration and fine breakup. Scaling cavitation or erosion directly by geometry therefore exceeds what Froude similarity alone can support for the prototype.
units.misconception: 福祿相似會自動保證所有水力現象相似~Froude similarity automatically preserves every hydraulic phenomenon.
units.practice: 用兩種長度縮尺計算相同原型流量所需模型流量，並列出速度與時間尺度，說明如何選尺寸兼顧供水能力及重要尺度效應。~For two length scales, calculate model flows representing one prototype flow and list velocity and time scales. Explain how model size balances laboratory supply capability against important scale effects.

units.anchor: 獨立量測加權估計~Independent measurement weighted estimate
units.title: 獨立量測加權估計~Independent measurement weighted estimate
units.mechanism: 多種儀器觀察同一位移時，可在誤差獨立且無偏的條件下依變異倒數加權，但精度高不代表沒有共同基準偏差。教材比較兩筆不同不確定度的量測，說明權重反映可信度而非簡單平均。融合前須確認兩者觀察同一位置、方向與時間，不可把不同物理量硬合併。 權重由標準差平方的倒數取得，而非標準差本身的倒數；兩者混用會讓低精度資料取得過大影響。~Measurements of one displacement can be weighted by inverse variance when errors are independent and unbiased, but precision does not exclude shared reference bias. Two observations with different uncertainties illustrate why weighting differs from a simple mean. Confirm matching location, direction and time before combining them as estimates of the same physical quantity. Weights use inverse variance, not inverse standard deviation; confusing the two gives the less precise observation too much influence in the combined displacement estimate.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm。模型邊界：獨立無偏高斯量測的加權平均，未處理共同漂移。~Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm. Model boundary: weighted mean for independent unbiased Gaussian observations, excluding shared drift.
units.verify: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。若兩者一起偏移但差值不變，需要外部基準；加權平均無法從兩份共同錯誤中恢復真值。~Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability. If both drift together while their difference remains constant, an external reference is required; weighted averaging cannot recover truth from two observations with the same bias.
units.failure: 過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。~An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. Unsynchronized observations can also turn a genuine reservoir-response change into an apparent disagreement between instruments observing the structure.
units.misconception: 加權平均一定能消除所有共同基準偏差~Weighted averaging always removes every shared reference bias.
units.practice: 對兩筆量測同時加入相同偏差，重算融合值並比較差值是否改變，再提出可揭露共同漂移的第三種獨立觀測與基準設計。~Add the same bias to both observations, recompute the fused estimate and check whether their difference changes. Propose a third independent observation and reference arrangement capable of exposing the shared drift.
